title: DeepSeek's AI Models Are About To Cost Four Times More
excerpt: DeepSeek has announced price hikes for its V4 models.
content_html:
Prices at off-peak hours will be half the peak-hour pricing.

Leon Neal/Getty Images

DeepSeek made its name offering far cheaper AI services than its pricier western competitors, but the cheap ride appears to be at an end. The company has started telling customers to prepare for significant price rises with the advent of its latest model. With the announcement of DeepSeek V4 Pro, the company is raising its API pricing fourfold. The company said it's adopting a new peak and off-peak pricing to "allocate resources more reasonably."

Starting on August 16, the DeepSeek V4 Pro model will cost $3.96 for 1 million output tokens at peak hours, more than four times the current rate of $0.87. It will cost you half that amount ($1.98) during off-peak hours. Meanwhile, the DeepSeek V4 Flash model will set you back $1.32 for 1 million output tokens (from $0.28) during peak hours and $0.66 during off-peak. 

To be fair, the current API pricing was supposed to be just a promotion ending on May 31. DeepSeek announced that month that it was going to make the discounted prices permanent, but it ultimately decided to proceed with the price hikes. 

Even though DeepSeek will soon cost four times more, its V4 models are still a lot more affordable than many of its competitors. Kimi K3, a model by Chinese company Moonshot, costs $15 per 1 million output tokens. OpenAI's most advanced model, GPT-5.6 Sol, costs $30 for 1 million output tokens. However, its low cost offering, GPT-5.6 Luna, costs $1.20, less than the DeepSeek V4 Flash at peak hours.

非高峰时段的价格将是高峰时段价格的一半。

莱昂尼尔/盖蒂图片社

DeepSeek 因提供比价格更高的西方竞争对手便宜得多的人工智能服务而闻名，但廉价之旅似乎已经结束。 随着最新型号的出现，该公司已开始告诉客户为价格大幅上涨做好准备。 随着 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的发布，该公司将其 API 定价提高了四倍。 该公司表示，正在采用新的高峰和非高峰定价，以“更合理地分配资源”。

从 8 月 16 日开始，DeepSeek V4 Pro 模型在高峰时段输出 100 万个代币的价格为 3.96 美元，是当前 0.87 美元价格的四倍多。 非高峰时段的费用是该费用的一半（1.98 美元）。 与此同时，DeepSeek V4 Flash 模型在高峰时段将花费 1.32 美元购买 100 万个输出代币（原价 0.28 美元），在非高峰时段花费 0.66 美元。

公平地说，当前的 API 定价应该只是 5 月 31 日结束的促销活动。 DeepSeek 当月宣布将永久实行折扣价，但最终决定继续提价。

尽管 DeepSeek 的价格很快就会高出四倍，但其 V4 型号仍然比许多竞争对手便宜得多。 Kimi K3是中国Moonshot公司的一款模型，每100万个产出代币的成本为15美元。 OpenAI 最先进的模型 GPT-5.6 Sol，100 万个输出代币的成本为 30 美元。 然而，其低成本产品 GPT-5.6 Luna 的成本为 1.20 美元，低于高峰时段的 DeepSeek V4 Flash。
